Bloom
Full-length look on a
black-and-ivory checkerboard
stage
floor before deep red velvet
curtains: curled copper-red hair
half pinned up, a botanical
jacquard mini dress with a
sweetheart corset bodice, rust-red
straps and a dramatic rust ruffle
sweeping across the waist over a
full flared skirt, and matching
jacquard ankle-strap platform
heels.
